question:
Simplify the following expression:

(15 ÷ 3) - [{(19 - 1) ÷ 2} - {5 × 20 - (7 × 9 - (-2))}]
solution:
**Given:**

(15 ÷ 3) - [{(19 - 1) ÷ 2} - {5 × 20 - (7 × 9 - (-2))}]

Concept Used:

Follow BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/39d5d53fbef7cb246c82384c70b63b0287aa26f6cdb11ad3d427215025057797.png] 

**Calculations:**

(15 ÷ 3) - [{(19 - 1) ÷ 2} - {5 × 20 - (7 × 9 - (-2))}]

⇒ (5) - [{(18) ÷ 2} - {100 - (63 + 2)}]

⇒ (5) - [{9} - {100 - 65}]

⇒ (5) - [{9} - {35}]

⇒ (5) - [9 - 35]

⇒ (5) - [- 26] = 31

**∴ The simplified value of the given equation**** is ****31.**
